purpose: Five distinct online lesson engines mapped to the five-role working-artist week.

shared_frame.primary_cta_rule: one primary CTA visible at a time
shared_frame.page_rule: one dominant learning job per page
shared_frame.mastery_gate: The next lesson/assignment remains locked until every required input section is completed, every scored mastery section reaches at least 80%, and every required artifact/evidence upload for the current lesson is present.
shared_frame.required_evidence_behavior: Visual/business assignments cannot receive credit or unlock progression until required image/screenshot evidence and metadata are present.

engines.title: Skills & Technique Day Engine
engines.assessment: technique criteria, practice evidence and transfer

engines.title: Artpreneur Day Engine
engines.assessment: functional asset checklist and real-world usability

engines.title: Marketing & Promotion Day Engine
engines.mode: audience, outreach and learning from response
engines.assessment: documented outreach action, usable promotion and response learning

engine_boundaries.artistic_taste: never graded as objective mastery; completion, knowledge, function and evidence are graded instead
engine_boundaries.popularity: likes, follows and virality are never mastery criteria
engine_boundaries.public_posting: offline/controlled alternatives always permitted; minors follow guardian/Academy safety rules
engine_boundaries.purchasing: students are never required to buy a product merely to complete a business lesson

assessment_system.philosophy: Arts grades measure completion, knowledge mastery, professional evidence and required process—not subjective artistic taste.
assessment_system.progression_rule: The next lesson/assignment remains locked until every required input section is completed, every scored mastery section reaches at least 80%, and every required artifact/evidence upload for the current lesson is present.

required_inputs.scoring: binary completion or explicit functional checklist
required_inputs.rule: A missing required field cannot be offset by a high score elsewhere.

vocabulary.retry: allowed after review; incorrect/missing terms remain visible for correction

pass_condition: required image/screenshot/photo uploaded to portfolio evidence
visual_or_business_artifact.scoring: completion/functional evidence only; no aesthetic taste score

reflection_or_decision_log.scoring: completion plus factual/functional criteria where applicable

required_for: artwork and studies designated as visual assignments
online portfolio screenshots or exported views
social media/promotional posts or offline promotional equivalents
artist-call application materials when visual evidence is part of the assignment
other visual business assets designated by the lesson
portfolio_evidence.credit_rule: No visual/business artifact receives assignment credit until required portfolio evidence is attached.

assessments.vocabulary_module: embedded throughout each unit and included in mastery gating
assessments.midterm: required; >=80% to proceed into post-midterm gated work

lesson_gate_algorithm: verify every required input is non-empty/complete
verify every required artifact has portfolio evidence
verify each scored mastery component is >=80%
verify weekly quiz requirement for the relevant checkpoint is >=80%
only then mark lesson mastered and unlock next lesson
assessment_system.retake_policy: Below 80% does not erase work. The student reviews/corrects incomplete or incorrect items and retries. Existing artifact uploads remain unless the learner replaces them.
assessment_system.artistic_freedom: The program does not grade whether the artwork is beautiful, fashionable, marketable or stylistically approved. It grades whether the learner completed the assigned problem, documented the evidence and mastered the knowledge/functional criteria.
